# arin_rdap_network (Data Source)

Look up the public ARIN network registration containing an IPv4/IPv6 address or canonical prefix. No API key is sent. Returns registration data, not proof of authority to modify the network. Referrals and partial results are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
data "arin_rdap_network" "example" {
  query = "192.0.2.1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `query` (String) Canonical IPv4/IPv6 address or network prefix without host bits.

### Read-Only

- `cidrs` (List of String) cidrs returned by ARIN.
- `country` (String) country returned by ARIN.
- `end_address` (String) end address returned by ARIN.
- `events` (Attributes List) events returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `handle` (String) handle returned by ARIN.
- `ip_version` (String) ip version returned by ARIN.
- `name` (String) name returned by ARIN.
- `network_type` (String) network type returned by ARIN.
- `org_handles` (List of String) org handles returned by ARIN.
- `parent_handle` (String) parent handle returned by ARIN.
- `rdap_json` (String) Complete RDAP registration JSON, including nested entities, links, notices, remarks and extensions. No links are followed.
- `start_address` (String) start address returned by ARIN.
- `status` (List of String) status returned by ARIN.

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) action returned by ARIN.
- `date` (String) date returned by ARIN.
